generator: make_snow_map.py (deterministic - fixed seeds, no per-machine randomness)
coordinates: Blender world: X = east, Y = north, Z = up, metres, SW corner (0,0), map 380 x 380. pos = world position of the FBX pivot (bottom-centre of the piece; terrain chunk = chunk centre at z = -12; merged world meshes = world origin). See unity_axis_mapping for the Blender -> Unity conversion.

export_rules.naming: snow_<category>_<name>_<vNN>.fbx, material name = palette colour name (e.g. snow_light), one object per file (variant families may share a file)
export_rules.fbx: axis_forward='-Z', axis_up='Y', apply_scale_options='FBX_SCALE_ALL', use_selection=True, mesh_smooth_type='FACE', meshes only, no animation
export_rules.pivot: bottom-centre of the piece; scale/rotation applied; 1 unit = 1 m; windmill sails = separate object with pivot at hub, spin about the Blender Y axis (see unity_axis_mapping.windmill)
export_rules.materials: colour-only materials from the approved palette (incl. N1 stone_deep #6E6A78, N2 ice_mid #8FD0E4, N3 red_deep #9C3B32), emission only on glow/ember; no textures, no UV
export_rules.terrain: 4 x 4 chunks of 95 x 95 m, each its own fbx, each <= 4,000 tris; pivot at bottom-centre of the chunk (z = -12 m skirt bottom)
export_rules.repeats: export one piece per prototype and place copies from 'instances'

unity_axis_mapping.fbx_contents_verified: Every .fbx (123) stores vertices in raw Blender axes (x east, y north, z up) and a root Model with Lcl Rotation (-90,0,0); GlobalSettings Up=+Y Front=+Z Coord=+X, UnitScaleFactor=100 (1 unit = 1 m in Unity). Parsed from the binary files, not imported.
unity_axis_mapping.mesh_local_in_unity: (x, y, z)_blender -> (-x, z, -y)_unity when the FBX root keeps its X -90 rotation (Unity mirrors X on import). Same behaviour as the cottage/fence already in the game (Blender front -Y faces Unity +Z; see Docs/asset-import/status-1.md). Not yet checked inside the Unity editor.
unity_axis_mapping.world_position: Blender (E, N, Z) -> Unity (E, Z, N) = (x, z, y). Terrain chunk pivot_world (E, N, -12) -> Unity position (E, -12, N). Merged world meshes (pos 0,0,0) -> Unity (0,0,0).
unity_axis_mapping.prefab_wrapper: Because mesh_local_in_unity differs from world_position by a 180 deg yaw, put each FBX in a child GameObject rotated Y = 180 under the prefab root (same as the Pivot/FrontYaw trick in AssetImport.cs). Then local geometry = (x, z, y)_blender and root.position = (pos.x, pos.z, pos.y).
unity_axis_mapping.instance_rotation: Blender Euler rot_deg (rx, ry, rz) applies to the root. Yaw: Unity rotation.y = -rz. General: Blender quaternion (w, x, y, z) -> Unity Quaternion(-x, -z, -y, w). Small tilts: Unity euler x = -rx, z = -ry (apply as the quaternion above for exactness).
unity_axis_mapping.windmill: snow_building_windmillbody_v01 pivot = bottom-centre; snow_building_windmillsails_v01 pivot = hub (origin of the sails mesh). Hub offset from the body origin in Blender = windmill_hub_offset_from_body_origin = (0, -3.3, 8.3) -> in the Y180 wrapper space (x, z, y) = (0, 8.3, -3.3). The sails disc lies in the Blender XZ plane (normal = Blender Y), so spin it about the Blender Y axis = wrapper-local Unity Z axis (transform.Rotate(0,0,deg, Space.Self)).
unity_axis_mapping.alias: Tree_Round_NNN objects in the layout (non_instanced_world_meshes) use the same mesh as snow_tree_round_v01 (verified vertex-identical); their transforms are in the .blend only.
